photos.desc: Botanical specimen in the Botanischer Garten, Frankfurt am Main, located at Siesmayerstraße 72, Frankfurt am Main, Germany. Carex strigosa hidden (?) among grass.
Young thin spiked wood sedge with stamens, stigmas and distinguishing short beaked utricles.
Carex strigosa in Beech Forest (Puszcza Bukowa) near Szczecin, NW Poland
